_comment: Machine-maintained state. NEVER hand-edit prose into this file: precheck.py reads it, postcheck.py rewrites it. This is the EMPTY TEMPLATE — the numbers under `policy` are starting defaults, not advice, and the rest fills itself in once a cycle runs the engine. Nothing runs it until you add precheck/postcheck to your own LOOP_PROMPT.md; see bot/README.md.

pass_list._note: Names examined and ruled out, with the reason. Re-adjudicated on the cadence in policy.pass_list_reexamine_quarters. Expiry forces a LOOK, never a buy.

deployment_clock.note: OFF by default, and leaving it off is a real choice. A clock sets a cash target with a deadline and a forcing backstop; the instance this engine came from ran one, deployed a large share of the account on a calendar into a falling tape, and retired it. If you turn it on, you are telling the loop it MUST buy by a date.

known_artifacts.pending_deposits: NON-EVIDENCE. It is the ACH echo of money already counted in cash. total_value excludes it. Never add to available capital.
known_artifacts.drip_orders: placed_agent='drip' fills are broker dividend reinvestment, not loop actions. Reconcile and move on.

policy._comment: STARTING DEFAULTS, not a recommendation. Every number here came from one person's book and is about to govern yours — read each one and change it, or delete the block and let your mandate rule. The engine reads these; your LOOP_PROMPT.md is what makes them binding.
